blocks.zh: 導論、術語表與低生物負荷產品概述
blocks.en: Introduction, Glossary and Overview of Low Bioburden Products

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解TR13-2與TR13的差異：低生物負荷產品（low bioburden products）與無菌產品的環境監測需求如何不同，以及TR13-2作為補充附錄的定位
blocks.en: Understand how TR13-2 differs from TR13: how the environmental monitoring (EM) needs of low bioburden products differ from those of sterile products, and the role of TR13-2 as a supplementary addendum

blocks.zh: 掌握本技術報告的15個核心術語，包括開放式系統（Open System）、功能性封閉系統（Functionally Closed System）與封閉式系統（Closed System）的定義差異
blocks.en: Master the 15 core terms of this technical report, including the differences among the definitions of Open System, Functionally Closed System and Closed System

blocks.zh: 了解低生物負荷製程的監測設計原則，包括單向氣流罩（UDF）在非無菌製程中的使用時機與風險評估方法
blocks.en: Understand the design principles for monitoring low bioburden processes, including when to use unidirectional flow (UDF) hoods in non-sterile processes and how to conduct the risk assessment

blocks.zh: 理解為何現有法規指引對低生物負荷產品的EM指導有限，及為何必須以風險評估驅動監測程序設計
blocks.en: Understand why existing regulatory guidance on EM for low bioburden products is limited, and why the monitoring program must be driven by risk assessment

blocks.zh: 解讀與應用
blocks.en: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 💡 概念｜TR13 vs. TR13-2：定位清楚不重疊
blocks.en: 💡 Concept | TR13 vs. TR13-2: clearly positioned, no overlap

blocks.zh: TR13-2 是 TR13 的補充附錄（addendum），兩者關係如下：
blocks.en: TR13-2 is a supplementary addendum to TR13. The relationship between the two is as follows:

blocks.zh: TR13（2014/2022）：針對無菌製藥（sterile products）——注射劑、凍乾製劑、眼用製劑等
blocks.en: TR13 (2014/2022): addresses sterile pharmaceutical products, such as injectables, lyophilized products and ophthalmic preparations

blocks.zh: TR13-2（2020）：針對需控制生物負荷但非無菌的製程——如生物原液（mAb drug substance）、細胞治療中間體、重組蛋白上游培養液
blocks.en: TR13-2 (2020): addresses processes that require bioburden control but are not sterile, such as biological drug substance (mAb drug substance), cell therapy intermediates and upstream culture fluids for recombinant proteins

blocks.zh: TR13-2 不取代 TR13；在設計 EM 程序時，兩份文件可能都需要參考，端看製程性質。
blocks.en: TR13-2 does not replace TR13. When designing an EM program, you may need to refer to both documents, depending on the nature of the process.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重點｜法規指引的空缺地帶
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key point | The gap in regulatory guidance

blocks.zh: 目前法規對三類製程均有明確指引：
blocks.en: Current regulations give clear guidance for three categories of process:

blocks.zh: 無菌製品：EU GMP Annex 1、FDA 無菌指引
blocks.en: Sterile products: EU GMP Annex 1 and FDA aseptic processing guidance

blocks.zh: 非無菌劑型：ICH Q6A、各國藥典
blocks.en: Non-sterile dosage forms: ICH Q6A and national pharmacopoeias

blocks.zh: ATMP：EU ATMP 法規（1394/2007）
blocks.en: ATMPs: EU ATMP Regulation (1394/2007)

blocks.zh: 但低生物負荷產品卻缺乏專屬指引。既有文件要麼沿用無菌製品標準（過於嚴苛），要麼僅建議「做風險評估」，缺乏具體操作框架——這正是 TR13-2 存在的原因。
blocks.en: However, low bioburden products have no dedicated guidance. Existing documents either apply the standards for sterile products (too stringent) or merely recommend "performing a risk assessment" without a concrete operating framework. This is exactly why TR13-2 exists.

blocks.zh: 🔄 類比｜混合地帶的監管困境
blocks.en: 🔄 Analogy | The regulatory dilemma of the in-between zone

blocks.zh: 想像一條高速公路（無菌製程規則）與一條鄉間小路（非無菌規則），低生物負荷製程就像一條介於兩者之間的「省道」——現有地圖（法規）只畫了高速公路和鄉間小路，省道必須靠駕駛人自行評估路況（風險評估）決定適用速限（監測要求）。
blocks.en: Imagine a highway (the rules for sterile processes) and a country lane (the rules for non-sterile processes). A low bioburden process is like a provincial road in between. The existing map (the regulations) shows only the highway and the country lane, so drivers must assess road conditions themselves (risk assessment) to decide which speed limit (monitoring requirements) applies.

blocks.zh: TR13-2 的目的，就是為這條省道畫出第一份系統性地圖。
blocks.en: The purpose of TR13-2 is to draw the first systematic map of this provincial road.

blocks.zh: 💡 概念｜1.1 Purpose：FMEA vs. HACCP vs. 混合法
blocks.en: 💡 Concept | 1.1 Purpose: FMEA vs. HACCP vs. a hybrid approach

blocks.zh: TR13-2 建議採用混合風險評估方法：
blocks.en: TR13-2 recommends a hybrid risk assessment approach:

blocks.zh: FMEA：從製程步驟出發，逐一評估每個步驟的失效模式、影響及發生機率；適合設備和操作分析
blocks.en: FMEA: starts from the process steps and evaluates the failure modes, effects and likelihood of occurrence of each step in turn; suited to equipment and operations analysis

blocks.zh: HACCP：識別關鍵控制點（CCP），設定限值並建立監測程序；源自食品工業，在生物製品製程中有良好應用基礎
blocks.en: HACCP: identifies critical control points (CCPs), sets limits and establishes monitoring procedures; it originated in the food industry and has a solid track record in biological product processes

blocks.zh: 混合法：兼取兩者優點，依製程特性靈活搭配
blocks.en: Hybrid approach: combines the strengths of both and is adapted flexibly to the characteristics of the process

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：EM 程序設計出來後，不應阻礙正常操作，也不應引入額外風險——這是 TR13-2 的核心設計原則。
blocks.en: Important reminder: once designed, the EM program should not hinder normal operations or introduce additional risk. This is the core design principle of TR13-2.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重點｜1.2 Scope：以可行性（viable）監測為核心
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key point | 1.2 Scope: centered on viable monitoring

blocks.zh: TR13-2 明確將焦點放在微生物（viable）監測，而非全面的環境監測：
blocks.en: TR13-2 explicitly focuses on viable (microbial) monitoring rather than comprehensive environmental monitoring:

blocks.zh: 微生物污染對生物原液的品質影響遠大於非生物粒子
blocks.en: Microbial contamination has a far greater impact on the quality of biological drug substance than nonviable particles do

blocks.zh: 製程本身常支持微生物生長（培養基、細胞培養液），使微生物控制更具挑戰
blocks.en: The process itself often supports microbial growth (culture media, cell culture fluids), which makes microbial control more challenging

blocks.zh: 非微生物粒子（nonviable）監測仍需執行，但不是本文件的重心
blocks.en: Nonviable particle monitoring must still be performed, but it is not the focus of this document

blocks.zh: 術語解析與實務對照
blocks.en: Glossary Analysis and Practical Comparison

blocks.zh: 💡 概念｜TR13-2 術語與TR13的差異
blocks.en: 💡 Concept | How the TR13-2 terminology differs from TR13

blocks.zh: TR13-2 的術語表不是 TR13 術語表的複製版，而是刻意修改或新創了部分定義，以反映低生物負荷製程的特殊性。例如：
blocks.en: The TR13-2 glossary is not a copy of the TR13 glossary. Some definitions were deliberately modified or newly created to reflect the particular nature of low bioburden processes. For example:

blocks.zh: Bioburden（TR13）：泛指所有存在於環境、人員、設備、原料中的微生物
blocks.en: Bioburden (TR13): refers broadly to all microorganisms present in the environment, personnel, equipment and raw materials

blocks.zh: Bioburden（TR13-2）：特指「滅菌前每單位材料中的微生物總數」——更聚焦於製程關鍵屬性
blocks.en: Bioburden (TR13-2): specifically "the total number of microorganisms per unit of material before sterilization", a definition more focused on critical process attributes

blocks.zh: Disinfection（TR13-2）：在 TR13 定義基礎上加入了具體的對數降低要求（3-log/2-log），更具操作指引性
blocks.en: Disinfection (TR13-2): builds on the TR13 definition by adding specific log reduction requirements (3-log/2-log), making it more operationally useful

blocks.zh: 閱讀時務必以本文件的定義為準，不能直接套用 TR13 術語的理解。
blocks.en: When reading, always rely on the definitions in this document; do not apply your understanding of the TR13 terms directly.

blocks.zh: 💡 概念｜四種 EM 監測類型的使用時機
blocks.en: 💡 Concept | When to use each of the four EM monitoring types

blocks.zh: TR13-2 將環境監測細分為四種類型，各有明確適用場景：
blocks.en: TR13-2 divides environmental monitoring into four types, each with a clearly defined application:

blocks.zh: Dynamic（動態）
blocks.en: Dynamic

blocks.zh: 生產操作進行中，人員可在可不在。適用於評估「操作狀態」下的環境品質。
blocks.en: Performed while production operations are in progress, with or without personnel present. Used to evaluate environmental quality in the "operational" state.

blocks.zh: Routine（例行頻率）
blocks.en: Routine

blocks.zh: 固定頻率（如每週、每月）評估整體設施管控狀態，非批次相關。
blocks.en: Performed at a fixed frequency (for example weekly or monthly) to assess the overall control status of the facility; not batch-related.

blocks.zh: Batch-related（批次相關）
blocks.en: Batch-related

blocks.zh: 在預定製程步驟時執行，可在有產品或無產品情況下進行。
blocks.en: Performed at predetermined process steps, with or without product present.

blocks.zh: Continuous（連續）
blocks.en: Continuous

blocks.zh: 批次期間持續監測，確保管控狀態維持並捕捉異常事件，頻率由風險評估決定。
blocks.en: Performed throughout the batch to confirm that the state of control is maintained and to capture abnormal events; the frequency is determined by risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 低生物負荷製程通常混合使用以上類型，而非單一選擇。
blocks.en: Low bioburden processes usually use a mix of these types rather than a single one.

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重點｜Critical Operations Monitoring（關鍵操作監測）
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key point | Critical Operations Monitoring

blocks.zh: Critical Operations Monitoring 是 TR13-2 的重要新術語，概念上接近 TR13 的「動態監測」，但更強調全程捕捉所有干預行為（interventions）、瞬時事件（transient events）和系統劣化（system deterioration）。
blocks.en: Critical Operations Monitoring is an important new term in TR13-2. It is conceptually close to the "dynamic monitoring" in TR13, but places more emphasis on capturing, throughout the operation, all interventions, transient events and system deterioration.

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異在於：監測的設計和力度必須根據製程風險決定：
blocks.en: The key difference is that the design and intensity of monitoring must be determined by process risk:

blocks.zh: 封閉系統 → 可降低監測密度
blocks.en: Closed system → monitoring density can be reduced

blocks.zh: BSC（生物安全櫃）保護下的開放步驟 → 中等密度
blocks.en: Open steps protected by a BSC (biological safety cabinet) → moderate density

blocks.zh: 無屏障的開放操作 → 最高密度，全程監測
blocks.en: Open operations without a barrier → highest density, with monitoring throughout

blocks.zh: 🏭 實務｜Low Bioburden Product 的典型例子
blocks.en: 🏭 Practice | Typical examples of low bioburden products

blocks.zh: 「低生物負荷產品」聽起來抽象，但在生物製藥產業非常具體：
blocks.en: "Low bioburden product" sounds abstract, but in the biopharmaceutical industry it is very concrete:

blocks.zh: 單株抗體原液（mAb drug substance）：CHO 細胞培養後的蛋白質原液，需控制生物負荷，但尚未進行除菌過濾
blocks.en: Monoclonal antibody drug substance (mAb drug substance): protein bulk after CHO cell culture, which requires bioburden control but has not yet undergone sterilizing filtration

blocks.zh: 重組蛋白中間體：層析純化後的蛋白質溶液，含有限度的生物負荷
blocks.en: Recombinant protein intermediates: protein solutions after chromatography purification, which carry a limited level of bioburden

blocks.zh: 細胞治療中間體：CAR-T 細胞在擴增培養階段（bioreactor）中的細胞懸液
blocks.en: Cell therapy intermediates: cell suspensions of CAR-T cells during the expansion stage (bioreactor)

blocks.zh: 病毒載體原液：腺病毒、AAV 等基因治療載體的製造中間體
blocks.en: Viral vector drug substance: manufacturing intermediates of gene therapy vectors such as adenovirus and AAV

blocks.zh: 這些產品的共同特徵：不要求無菌，但微生物超標會影響產品品質、安全性或下游除菌步驟的效能。
blocks.en: The shared characteristics of these products: sterility is not required, but excessive microbial levels can affect product quality, safety or the performance of the downstream sterilizing step.

blocks.zh: 🔄 類比｜Disinfection vs. Sanitization vs. Sterilization
blocks.en: 🔄 Analogy | Disinfection vs. Sanitization vs. Sterilization

blocks.zh: 三個「殺菌」術語常被混淆，TR13-2 的定義提供了清晰的層次：
blocks.en: Three terms for "killing microbes" are often confused. The TR13-2 definitions provide a clear hierarchy:

blocks.zh: Sanitization（消毒）：降至公共衛生安全水準——相對溫和，食品工業標準
blocks.en: Sanitization: reduction to a level considered safe for public health; relatively mild and the standard in the food industry

blocks.zh: Disinfection（滅菌消毒）：3-log 以上殺滅營養型微生物，2-log 以上殺滅細菌孢子——製藥潔淨室標準
blocks.en: Disinfection: at least a 3-log kill of vegetative microorganisms and at least a 2-log kill of bacterial spores; the standard for pharmaceutical cleanrooms

blocks.zh: Sterilization（滅菌）：消滅所有活性微生物——無菌製程標準（SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶）
blocks.en: Sterilization: destruction of all viable microorganisms; the standard for sterile processes (SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶)

blocks.zh: 低生物負荷製程的清潔驗證目標通常是 Disinfection，而非 Sterilization。
blocks.en: The cleaning validation target for a low bioburden process is usually disinfection, not sterilization.

blocks.zh: 📋 框架｜三種系統類型決定EM程序設計
blocks.en: 📋 Framework | Three system types determine the design of the EM program

blocks.zh: 系統類型（System Type）是決定 EM 監測強度的最關鍵變數：
blocks.en: System type is the most critical variable in determining the intensity of EM monitoring:

blocks.zh: 風險評估必須先確定系統類型，才能合理配置監測資源。
blocks.en: The risk assessment must first establish the system type before monitoring resources can be allocated sensibly.

blocks.zh: 低生物負荷製程設計原則解析
blocks.en: Analysis of Low Bioburden Process Design Principles

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重點｜Bioburden Reduction Steps — 被動性的副效果
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key point | Bioburden reduction steps: a passive side effect

blocks.zh: TR13-2 特別指出：純化（purification）和超濾（ultrafiltration）等製程步驟確實會降低生物負荷，但這不是其設計目的——它們是蛋白質純化工具，降低生物負荷只是副效果。
blocks.en: TR13-2 specifically points out that process steps such as purification and ultrafiltration do reduce bioburden, but this is not their design purpose. They are protein purification tools, and bioburden reduction is only a side effect.

blocks.zh: 這一點非常重要：製造商不能宣稱「我們有純化步驟，所以生物負荷自然會控制好」。風險評估必須明確識別真正的生物負荷控制機制，以及這些機制的已驗證能力。
blocks.en: This point is very important: a manufacturer cannot claim "we have a purification step, so bioburden will naturally be controlled." The risk assessment must clearly identify the actual bioburden control mechanisms and their demonstrated capability.

blocks.zh: 🔄 類比｜UDF 在非無菌製程中的角色
blocks.en: 🔄 Analogy | The role of UDF in non-sterile processes

blocks.zh: 在傳統無菌製程中，Grade A UDF（或 LAF）位於 Grade B 背景環境，是「無菌保護罩」。但在低生物負荷製程中，UDF 扮演的是「局部潔淨加強器」的角色：
blocks.en: In a traditional aseptic process, a Grade A UDF (or LAF) sits in a Grade B background environment and acts as a "sterile protective hood." In a low bioburden process, however, the UDF plays the role of a "local cleanliness enhancer":

blocks.zh: 操作步驟本身不是無菌操作
blocks.en: The operating step itself is not an aseptic operation

blocks.zh: Grade A 的目的是減少而非消除微生物進入的機會
blocks.en: The purpose of Grade A is to reduce, not eliminate, the opportunity for microorganisms to enter

blocks.zh: 背景環境可以是 Grade C，而非無菌製程要求的 Grade B
blocks.en: The background environment can be Grade C rather than the Grade B required for aseptic processes

blocks.zh: 著裝要求也應根據操作性質重新評估，不一定需要 Grade B 全身無菌著裝
blocks.en: Gowning requirements should also be reassessed according to the nature of the operation; full Grade B sterile gowning is not necessarily required

blocks.zh: 這種靈活性必須有書面風險評估作為支撐，不能只是口頭說「我覺得 Grade C 就夠了」。
blocks.en: This flexibility must be supported by a documented risk assessment; it cannot rest on a verbal "I think Grade C is enough."

blocks.zh: 🏭 實務｜UDF 接種準備案例深度解析
blocks.en: 🏭 Practice | In-depth analysis of the UDF inoculum preparation case

blocks.zh: TR13-2 第3節提供了一個非常具體的案例：在 Grade A UDF 中進行哺乳動物細胞培養的接種準備（inoculum preparation）。
blocks.en: Section 3 of TR13-2 provides a very specific case: inoculum preparation for mammalian cell culture performed in a Grade A UDF.

blocks.zh: 製程描述：將解凍的 cryovial 內容物轉移至無菌 T-flask，操作時間約2分鐘。
blocks.en: Process description: the contents of a thawed cryovial are transferred to a sterile T-flask; the operation takes about 2 minutes.

blocks.zh: Annex 1 的字面要求衝突：
blocks.en: Conflict with the literal requirements of Annex 1:

blocks.zh: Grade A 要求連續非微生物粒子計數 + 主動浮游菌採樣
blocks.en: Grade A requires continuous nonviable particle counting plus active viable air sampling

blocks.zh: 一般解讀：採樣量需達 1 m³（需5–35分鐘）
blocks.en: The usual interpretation: the sample volume must reach 1 m³ (which takes 5 to 35 minutes)

blocks.zh: 但製程本身只需2分鐘→完全矛盾
blocks.en: But the process itself takes only 2 minutes, which is a complete contradiction

blocks.zh: 風險評估結論示範：
blocks.en: Example risk assessment conclusions:

blocks.zh: 主要風險 = 活性微生物進入（非粒子）
blocks.en: The main risk = ingress of viable microorganisms (not particles)

blocks.zh: 在製程中執行非微生物粒子計數不僅無助於管控，反而因操作員分心而引入額外風險
blocks.en: Performing nonviable particle counts during the process would not help control the risk and would in fact introduce additional risk by distracting the operator

blocks.zh: 結論：製程中不執行粒子計數；在固定頻率下執行粒子計數以確認 UDF 功能正常
blocks.en: Conclusion: no particle counting during the process; particle counts are performed at a fixed frequency to confirm that the UDF is functioning properly

blocks.zh: 製程中執行浮游菌採樣（雖然只有2分鐘，採樣時間可涵蓋整個製程，符合法規精神）
blocks.en: Viable air sampling is performed during the process (although the process lasts only 2 minutes, the sampling time can cover the entire process, which is consistent with the intent of the regulation)

blocks.zh: 這個案例示範了「監測設計必須與風險評估一致」的核心原則。
blocks.en: This case illustrates the core principle that "monitoring design must be consistent with the risk assessment."

blocks.zh: 📋 框架｜成功風險評估的五大必備要素
blocks.en: 📋 Framework | The five essential elements of a successful risk assessment

blocks.zh: TR13-2 明確列出風險評估必須包含的組成要素，缺一不可：
blocks.en: TR13-2 explicitly lists the components that a risk assessment must include; none can be omitted:

blocks.zh: 跨部門代表：驗證、生產、品保、設施、微生物——需要多角度觀點，避免單一部門盲點
blocks.en: Cross-functional representatives: validation, manufacturing, quality assurance, facilities and microbiology; multiple perspectives are needed to avoid the blind spots of a single department

blocks.zh: 明確的風險問題：風險評估的核心問題必須事先定義，例如「接種準備步驟中最大的微生物污染風險是什麼？」
blocks.en: A clear risk question: the core question of the risk assessment must be defined in advance, for example "What is the greatest microbial contamination risk in the inoculum preparation step?"

blocks.zh: 詳細製程圖：每個操作步驟、設備銜接、物料移動都需要可視化
blocks.en: A detailed process map: every operating step, equipment connection and material movement needs to be visualized

blocks.zh: 設施平面圖：含人員動線和物料流向，識別潛在交叉污染路徑
blocks.en: A facility floor plan: including personnel flow and material flow, to identify potential cross-contamination paths

blocks.zh: 批次記錄和 SOP：確保風險評估基於實際操作流程，而非理想化假設
blocks.en: Batch records and SOPs: to ensure that the risk assessment is based on the actual operating procedure rather than idealized assumptions

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 重點｜「分級即適用所有要求」的陷阱
blocks.en: ⚠️ Key point | The "classified means all requirements apply" trap

blocks.zh: TR13-2 提出了一個業界常見困境：一旦某區域被分類為 EU Grade A，管理人員往往認為必須完全遵守 Annex 1 對 Grade A 的所有要求。
blocks.en: TR13-2 raises a dilemma common in industry: once an area is classified as EU Grade A, managers often assume that all Annex 1 requirements for Grade A must be fully complied with.

blocks.zh: 但 Annex 1 的設計初衷是無菌產品製造，並非低生物負荷的非無菌操作。TR13-2 的解決方案：
blocks.en: But Annex 1 was designed for sterile product manufacturing, not for non-sterile, low bioburden operations. The TR13-2 solution:

blocks.zh: 透過書面風險評估論證哪些 Grade A 要求適用於該製程
blocks.en: Use a documented risk assessment to justify which Grade A requirements apply to the process

blocks.zh: 哪些要求可以調整或豁免（附充分科學依據）
blocks.en: Determine which requirements can be adjusted or waived (with sufficient scientific justification)

blocks.zh: 或考慮採用 ISO 14644 分級（ISO 5/7/8）取代 EU Grade，更符合低生物負荷製程的語境
blocks.en: Or consider using ISO 14644 classification (ISO 5/7/8) in place of EU grades, which better fits the context of low bioburden processes

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：監測程序服務於製程需求，而非單純服從分級標籤。
blocks.en: Key principle: the monitoring program serves the needs of the process; it does not simply comply with a classification label.

blocks.zh: 💡 概念｜TR13-2 的核心名言
blocks.en: 💡 Concept | The core statement of TR13-2

blocks.zh: 中文理解：「製程監測的設計，必須與風險評估結論一致，並反映該製程實際需要的監測程度。」
blocks.en: In plain terms: "The design of process monitoring must be consistent with the conclusions of the risk assessment and must reflect the level of monitoring that the process actually requires."

blocks.zh: 這句話的意涵是：不是監測得越多越好，也不是越少越好——而是剛好足夠支撐製程品質保證。過度監測（如強迫執行無意義的粒子計數）可能引入操作風險；監測不足則無法發現污染趨勢。
blocks.en: What this means: more monitoring is not necessarily better, and less is not better either; the goal is just enough to support process quality assurance. Excessive monitoring (such as forcing meaningless particle counts) can introduce operational risk, while insufficient monitoring cannot detect contamination trends.

blocks.zh: 💡 概念｜無菌 vs. 低生物負荷：目標根本不同
blocks.en: 💡 Concept | Sterile vs. low bioburden: fundamentally different goals

blocks.zh: 這是本節最重要的認知框架：
blocks.en: This is the most important conceptual framework in this section:

blocks.zh: 生物製程（如細胞培養）的難題在於：培養基本身就是微生物的絕佳培養環境，任何進入的污染物都會快速繁殖，因此製程設計和環境管控必須在源頭阻絕。
blocks.en: The difficulty with biological processes (such as cell culture) is that the culture medium is itself an ideal growth environment for microorganisms, and any contaminant that enters will multiply quickly, so process design and environmental control must block contamination at the source.

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 定位與範圍
blocks.en: Positioning and scope

blocks.zh: TR13-2 是 TR13 的補充附錄，針對低生物負荷製程（非無菌）
blocks.en: TR13-2 is a supplementary addendum to TR13 and addresses low bioburden (non-sterile) processes

blocks.zh: 填補現有法規（無菌/非無菌/ATMP）之間對低生物負荷製程的指引空缺
blocks.en: It fills the gap in existing regulatory guidance (sterile / non-sterile / ATMP) for low bioburden processes

blocks.zh: 以可行性（viable）微生物監測為核心，FMEA/HACCP 混合風險評估為工具
blocks.en: It is centered on viable microbial monitoring, with a hybrid FMEA/HACCP risk assessment as the tool

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：生物製藥原液、細胞治療中間體、小分子等需生物負荷控制的製程
blocks.en: Scope of application: processes that require bioburden control, such as biopharmaceutical drug substance, cell therapy intermediates and small molecules

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語與概念
blocks.en: Key terms and concepts

blocks.zh: 三種系統類型（封閉/功能性封閉/開放）決定監測強度
blocks.en: Three system types (closed / functionally closed / open) determine monitoring intensity

blocks.zh: 四種 EM 監測類型（動態/例行/批次/連續）靈活搭配
blocks.en: Four EM monitoring types (dynamic / routine / batch-related / continuous) are combined flexibly

blocks.zh: UDF 在非無菌製程中的角色：局部 Grade A 保護罩，背景可為 Grade C
blocks.en: Role of UDF in non-sterile processes: a local Grade A protective hood, with a background that can be Grade C

blocks.zh: 核心原則：監測設計必須與風險評估一致，服務製程需求而非僅服從分級標籤
blocks.en: Core principle: monitoring design must be consistent with the risk assessment and serve the needs of the process, not merely comply with a classification label
